user.title: DTEK Grid Monitoring
user.description: Configure one DTEK address and the sensor that reports whether it has power. Monitoring starts automatically when that sensor switches to the outage state.

data_description.city: As written on the DTEK site, e.g. “м. Одеса”.
data_description.street: As written on the DTEK site, e.g. “вул. Пантелеймонівська”.
data_description.houses: Comma-separated, e.g. “9” or “33А, 33/А”. The best match is chosen automatically.
data_description.source_entity: When this entity changes to the state below, DTEK monitoring begins; when it leaves that state, monitoring ends.
data_description.power_off_state: Usually “off” for a grid binary sensor.

error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve data from DTEK for this address. Check the URL, city and street spelling.
error.no_houses: Enter at least one house number.

abort.already_configured: This address and source sensor are already configured.

data.initial_interval: Interval while DTEK has no info (minutes)
